carrier.interpretation: odd cotangent saddle of the automorphism constraint complex

not_claimed: an open family of non-conformally-flat backgrounds
claim_boundary.statement: The curvature-corrected Nariai automorphism constraint complex admits the canonical action-derived odd-cotangent Bach extension. Its 288-component eight-block differential is nilpotent and odd cyclic, and the exact four-row metric Bach complex embeds isometrically as the corrected BGG graph. The middle operator is the Hessian of 1/2<h,B_action h>+<lambda,M^D a-Phi h>; every cotangent and identity arrow is forced by the displayed pairings.

formal_adjoint_completion.B_action_sharp: B_action by the Weyl-squared second variation
formal_adjoint_completion.K_p0_sharp: formal adjoint of K_p0 with C0/H1 pairings
formal_adjoint_completion.M_D_sharp: M_D by the parent Yang-Mills action
formal_adjoint_completion.Phi_sharp: formal adjoint of Phi with H1/C1dual pairings
formal_adjoint_completion.d_aut_sharp: formal adjoint of d_aut with C0/C1 pairings
